From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & stakeholder mapping — Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — the demo was helpful. A few clarifications from procurement and legal so we can move internally:

- Confirmed economic buyer: James Patel (VP Product). I'll introduce him on the follow-up.
- InfoSec contact: Priya Menon (priya.menon@acme.com) — she'll want SOC 2 Type II and specifics on data residency and access controls.
- Procurement notes:
  • Standard process: PO + SOW + signed T&Cs.
  • Exceptions requested: 60-day payment terms (our default is 30 days), a first-year discount beyond your list pricing, and an SLA with financial credits for downtime (they specifically asked about 99.9% uptime with tiered credits).

On discounts, James will want economics spelled out for exec review — he asked for a comparison vs. managed alternatives. For the SLA, procurement asked whether your standard SLA includes financial credits and what caps you recommend.

Can you share a proposed exception (discount band + payment term + SLA credit cap) we can take to procurement/legal?

Thanks — I'll coordinate pulling in James and Priya on the next call.

—Sarah
Sarah Lee
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Acme Corp
sarah.lee@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Acme procurement exception request — discount & SLA

Team,

Looping you in — Acme (high priority, potential $1.2M ARR first-year) has asked for a set of procurement exceptions: 60-day payment terms, a first-year discount beyond standard (they asked about a 30% reduction), and a 99.9% SLA with financial credits.

Requesting quick guidance / approval so we can respond with a concrete proposal to procurement next week. My suggested options:

Option A (conservative):
- Discount: 15% first year
- Payment terms: 30 days
- SLA: standard SLA; financial credits up to 3% monthly MRC cap

Option B (accelerate close):
- Discount: 25% first year
- Payment terms: 45 days
- SLA: 99.9% uptime with credits capped at 5% monthly MRC

Option C (deal desk escalation):
- Discount up to 30% and 60-day terms; legal approval required for SLA credits >5%

Attachments: RDW_Acme_SOW_draft_v1.docx (see proposed redlines in section 4: SLA & billing)

Can you please reply with approvals or edits? Need to get back to Sarah by Monday EOD.

Thanks,
Marissa
(For context: HubSpot deal #1234567)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme procurement exception request — discount & SLA

Marissa — quick legal review notes: we can accept the requested redlines with these constraints:

- Discount: commercial decision — fine to approve up to 25% for renewals < $2M if Finance signs off.
- Payment terms: 45 days acceptable.
- SLA / financial credits: we should cap credits at 5% monthly MRC. Any credits beyond that expose the company to outsized credit risk; do not agree to unconditional credits tied to multi-day outages. We should also add carve-outs for scheduled maintenance and force majeure.
- Security/Access: Priya (InfoSec) will need SOC 2 Type II and a data handling appendix. If Acme requests additional privileged access, legal will require an approved security exception ticket and a defined scope.

I'll prepare redlines for the SOW/T&Cs (highlighting the SLA credit cap and carve-outs). Recommend we offer Option B with SLA credits capped at 5% and 45-day terms — that gives us runway to close while limiting legal exposure.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Approval: Acme procurement exceptions (conditional)

Approving Option B with the following firm conditions:

- Discount: 25% first year (no further discounts without VP/Director approval)
- Payment terms: 45 days
- SLA: 99.9% uptime with financial credits capped at 5% monthly MRC; include carve-outs for scheduled maintenance and force majeure
- Security: require SOC 2 Type II evidence and signed data handling appendix before any production access
- Condition: Legal to finalize redlines; Finance to confirm ARR math and margin impact (Lauren), then we proceed to procurement signature.

Please prepare the revised SOW/T&Cs and I'll send the approval note to Sarah / James once redlines are in. Deal Id: RDW-ACME-2026-11.

Aditya
Aditya Rao | Sales Director, Redwood Inference
